scenes.text: Quiz time! 6 tricky questions, from episodes 31 to 40. [1] Five seconds each. Count how many you get right. [2] Ready? Let's go!
Question 1. What does LoRA mainly train? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Small adapter matrices! The big model stays frozen.

Question 2. A 7 billion parameter model at 4 bits. Roughly how much memory do its weights need? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] About 3.5 gigabytes. Four bits is half a byte, times seven billion.
Question 3. Why add a reranker after vector search? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Vector search is fast but rough. The reranker checks which chunks truly answer the question.

data.question: Why add a reranker?
options: It checks which chunks truly answer

scenes.text: Question 4. What does open weights actually mean? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] The weights can be downloaded! The training data is often still private, and running it still costs money.
Question 5. With most AI APIs, which usually costs more per token? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Output tokens, the text the model writes, usually cost several times more.
Question 6. What is benchmark contamination? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Test questions leaked into the training data, so the model has already seen the answers.
So, how many did you get? [1] 6 out of 6? You're a true AI Maastaaru! [2] 4 or 5, great work. [3] 3 or less? Rewatch episodes 31 to 40, and try again. [4] Comment your score below!
